overview.en:
Explore engineering delivery metrics, repository activity and AI adoption with LinearB’s official MCP.

Review software-delivery and repository metrics with a consistent team and reporting period. Explain metric definitions before drawing conclusions about changes.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 LinearB 官方 MCP 分析研发交付指标、仓库活动与 AI 采用情况。

在一致的团队与报告期内查看软件交付和仓库指标，先解释指标定义，再对变化作出判断。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this team's available delivery metrics for last month.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个团队上个月的可用交付指标。

starterPrompts.en: Compare repository activity across these reporting periods.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这些报告期内的仓库活动。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an engineering review with the available AI adoption data.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 结合可用 AI 采用数据准备研发复盘。
